Model of the last satisfiable check

Source: R/models.R, R/solver.R
z3_model.Rd

Returns the model found by the most recent z3_check(). A model is only available when that check returned "sat" and the solver has not been changed since (by z3_add(), z3_push(), z3_pop() or z3_reset()), so a model never describes constraints it was not computed for.

Usage

# S3 method for class 'z3_context'
z3_model(x)

z3_model(x)

Arguments

x

A z3_solver or z3_optimize.

Value

A z3_model.

Details

The returned model is a snapshot: it stays valid after the solver changes.

See also

z3_eval(), z3_model_values().

Examples

ctx <- z3_context()
x <- z3_int(ctx, "x")
s <- z3_solver(ctx)
z3_add(s, x * x == 49, x < 0)
z3_check(s)
#> [1] "sat"
m <- z3_model(s)
z3_eval(m, x)
#> <z3_expr Int> (- 7)
